title: Afternoon Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Afternoon Sunwatch — October 08, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C1.3)
🔥 Latest solar flare: M6.7 (Peaked October 08, 2026 at 15:48 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 354 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.33)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Type II Radio Emission

Sunny caught an M-Class flare! 🔥💣🌞📡

A bright active region stands out in today’s solar images, while the coronagraph view shows no clear large outward-moving feature.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 131 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
